itineraries.title: Five days on Crete’s north coast
itineraries.intro: Chania, Rethymno and the Venetian harbours.

days.note: Board in Chania; the Venetian harbour.
The lagoon of pink sand and turquoise shallows below the Gramvousa peninsula.
The fortezza and the old town.
The uninhabited island off Heraklion; a quiet anchorage for the last night.
Knossos in the morning, then the archaeological museum before sailing.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Chania to Elounda
itineraries.intro: The length of Crete’s north coast, ending in the Mirabello bay.

days.note: The Venetian harbour and lighthouse; the covered market and the old town.
The Venetian fortress on the islet and the shipwreck in the bay.
The fortezza over the harbour and the long town beach.
Knossos in the morning, then the archaeological museum before sailing.
The uninhabited island off Heraklion; a quiet anchorage for the last night.
The lake in the middle of town and the coves of the Mirabello gulf.
The lagoon and the sunken city of Olous; Spinalonga’s fortress island by tender.
